hooks.command:
bash -euo pipefail -c '
input="$(cat)"
jq --slurpfile meta <(head -n 1 "$(jq -r ".transcript_path // \"/dev/null\"" <<<"$input")") "$1" <<<"$input"
' -- '
    def parent: sub("/[^/]+$"; "");
    (first($meta[].payload.source | objects | .subagent | objects | .thread_spawn | objects)
        // {agent_path: "/root"}) as $self
    | ((.tool_input | objects) // {}) as $call
    | (($call.target // "") | if startswith("/") then . else "\($self.agent_path)/\(.)" end) as $target
    | first(
        (select(.tool_name | endswith("spawn_agent"))
            | select(($call.fork_turns // "") | tostring | test("^\\s*none\\s*$"; "i") | not)
            | "Set `fork_turns` to \"none\" and put necessary context in the brief"),
        (select(.tool_name | endswith("followup_task"))
            | select(($target | parent) != $self.agent_path)
            | "`followup_task` reaches only an agent you spawned: a result returns to the spawning agent"),
        (select(.tool_name | endswith("send_message"))
            | select(($target | parent) != $self.agent_path and ($self.agent_path | startswith($target + "/") | not))
            | "`send_message` reaches only your ancestors and the agents you spawned. Report boundary crossings upward")
    )
    | {hookSpecificOutput: {hookEventName: "PreToolUse", permissionDecision: "deny", permissionDecisionReason: .}}
'
